# Gramlot 0.3.20

- Expose host-provided `db(name)` and `async_db(name)` on Python Page and PageStore.
- Add the protected invocation seam used by hosts to execute page methods and synchronous PageStore recipes with their own worker and resource lifetime.
- Keep database engines, sessions and web framework dependencies outside the core. A host without database access reports it explicitly.

The Kajenn implementation is provided by gramlot-py-server. PageStore recipes remain synchronous and process-local; this release does not add async controllers, reconnect/replay or persistence of PageStore Bags.
